summary: Implemented the localized provider type selection surface for AUTH-07 and AUTH-08. The UI derives its three options from the approved provider contract, supports default and selected states, keyboard focus, responsive layouts, Arabic RTL and English/Simplified Chinese LTR, and hands off only a validated providerType to the next onboarding route without exposing OTP or session authority.

apps/api/src/modules/provider/router.ts and API inventory: POST /api/v1/provider/application is implemented and synchronized, but is intentionally not called by type selection
apps/web/src/features/provider_auth/pages.tsx and apps/web/tests/provider-type.vitest.test.tsx: validated selection, query handoff, direction, and token-safe route behavior

scopeNotes: apps/web/src/features/auth/pages.tsx is outside the task's feature root and was changed only as an explicit necessity exception: the existing /auth/* dispatcher rendered an unavailable state for /auth/register/provider/type, so the selected provider page could not be reached without this one-path integration.

The next route carries only providerType and the existing locale query. OTP verificationToken, access tokens, refresh cookies, and private application data are not submitted, stored, placed in URLs, or rendered by frontend_022.
Provider account creation remains at the implemented API boundary and is owned by the subsequent onboarding task; no production mock or invented endpoint was added.
No Backend truth repair, dependency, contract, OpenAPI, Postman, database, or root truth change was required for this task.
knownGaps: The provider account fields reached through /auth/register/provider/account are owned by frontend_023 and are intentionally not implemented in frontend_022.
The local design exports were used as the visual source of truth; the recorded Drive/Figma references remain the external design provenance.
